Primary stability of a cementless modular revision hip stem in relation with the femoral defect size: A biomechanical study

High Hip Implant & Femoral Stem openalex Direct Read now mechanical_testing Exp. validation
Martin Ellenrieder, Robert Souffrant, Christian Schulze, Daniel Kluess, Wolfram Mittelmeier et al. Journal of orthopaedic surgery 2020-09-01 10.1177/2309499020948991
单位: Department of Orthopaedics, University Medicine Rostock, Rostock, Germany
通讯: Martin Ellenrieder @ Department of Orthopaedics, University Medicine Rostock, Rostock, Germany
相关性: 该论文直接测量了不同骨缺损尺寸下翻修髋关节假体的微动和沉降，为Gruen区应力分析和接触建模提供了实验基准。
边界: This paper does not include finite element analysis, stress shielding quantification, or patient-specific modeling.
动机· 确定翻修髋关节假体稳定所需的最小骨接触长度。
方法· 在复合股骨上模拟七种骨缺损，测量轴向和扭转加载下的微动与沉降。
结果· 7厘米接触长度时微动66微米，5厘米时超过100微米并出现旋转不稳。
验证· 使用复合股骨进行力学测试，对比不同缺损类型。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To determine the minimum diaphyseal bone contact length required for stable osseointegration of cementless fluted revision hip stems.
Method· Cyclic axial and torsional loading was applied to composite femora with seven defect types (Paprosky I–IIIB), and implant-bone micromotions and subsidence were measured using LVDTs.
Result· A 7-cm contact zone yielded mean micromotions of 66 µm, while a 5-cm zone resulted in micromotions exceeding 100 µm and rotational instability.
Validation· Experimental mechanical testing on composite femora with controlled defect geometries.
primary stability · 初始稳定性micromotion · 微动subsidence · 沉降cementless fluted stem · 非骨水泥带凹槽柄revision hip arthroplasty · 翻修髋关节置换术Paprosky classification · Paprosky分型bone defect · 骨缺损composite femur · 复合股骨rotational instability · 旋转不稳

Arindam Chakraborty, Pallab Datta, Santanu Majumder, Subhas Chandra Mondal, Amit Roychowdhury Computers in biology and medicine 2020-09-01 10.1016/j.compbiomed.2020.103839
单位: Department of Aerospace Engineering and Applied Mechanics, Indian Institute of Engineering Science and Technology, Shibpur, P.O.- Botanic Garden, Howrah, 711103, West Bengal, India. Electronic address
通讯: Arindam Chakraborty @ Department of Aerospace Engineering and Applied Mechanics, Indian Institute of Engineering Science and Technology, Shibp  |  Pallab Datta @ Centre of Healthcare Science and Technology, Indian Institute of Engineering Science and Technology, Shibpur, P.O.- Bota  |  Santanu Majumder @ Department of Aerospace Engineering and Applied Mechanics, Indian Institute of Engineering Science and Technology, Shibp  |  Subhas Chandra Mondal @ Department of Mechanical Engineering, Indian Institute of Engineering Science and Technology, Shibpur, P.O.- Botanic Gar  |  Amit Roychowdhury @ Department of Aerospace Engineering and Applied Mechanics, Indian Institute of Engineering Science and Technology, Shibp
相关性: 该论文通过多孔结构调节刚度以减少应力遮挡，并采用增材制造和力学测试，但缺乏疲劳、表面粗糙度和骨整合分析。
边界: No fatigue testing, no surface roughness or osseointegration analysis.
动机· 根据患者骨条件设计定制化刚度种植体以减小应力遮挡
方法· FEA结合实验测试不同孔径和孔隙率的多孔钛合金种植体
结果· 700-900μm孔径及10%孔隙率种植体适用于骨质较弱患者
验证· 微CT验证制造精度，实验变形与FEA差异9.7%
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To minimize stress shielding by designing patient-specific dental implants with stiffness tailored to bone condition.
Method· Finite element analysis and experimental testing were performed on Ti-6Al-4V implants with varying pore sizes (500-900 μm) and porosities (10-30%) fabricated via additive manufacturing.
Result· Implants with 700-900 μm pore size and 10% porosity were found suitable for weak bone conditions based on peri-implant micro-strain criteria.
Validation· Micro-CT assessed fabrication accuracy, and experimental deformation under 200 N load showed 9.7% average difference from FEA.

动机· 制备纳米结构羟基磷灰石涂层以增强钛植入体的早期骨整合。

Motivation· To fabricate nanostructured hydroxyapatite coatings on titanium via electrochemical deposition for enhanced early-stage osseointegration.
Method· Nanoplate-like HA coatings were prepared by electrochemical deposition and compared with acid/alkali-treated and plasma-sprayed HA coatings.

Validation· In vitro MC3T3-E1 cell assays and in vivo push-out tests with histological assessment were performed.

Motivation· To enhance the microstructure and surface topography of NiTi parts fabricated by laser powder bed fusion through process parameter optimization.
Method· Systematic variation of laser power, scan speed, and other parameters, followed by microstructural and surface characterization.

Medium AM Biomedical Materials openalex Direct Save for project numerical_benchmark UQ
Godlove Wanki, Stephen Ekwaro-Osire, João‐Paulo Dias, Américo Cunha Journal of Verification Validation and Uncertainty Quantification 2020-09-01 10.1115/1.4048749
单位: Department of Mechanical Engineering, Texas Tech University, Lubbock, TX 79409
通讯: Godlove Wanki @ Department of Mechanical Engineering, Texas Tech University, Lubbock, TX 79409
相关性: 该论文直接研究多孔股骨柄的力学性能不确定性量化，与用户关注的LPBF制造、应力遮挡和疲劳性能相关。
边界: The paper focuses on uncertainty quantification and stiffness prediction, but does not include LPBF fabrication, fatigue testing, or surface roughness characterization.
动机· 多孔股骨柄参数不确定性影响力学性能，需量化其效应。
方法· 基于最大熵原理建立稀疏参数不确定性量化框架。
结果· 框架有效量化了支柱厚度、孔径等不确定性对刚度的影响。
验证· 利用文献实验数据验证，遵循ASME标准。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· The variability of sparsely characterized parameters in porous femoral stems necessitates a rigorous uncertainty quantification framework to improve model credibility.
Method· A UQ framework based on the maximum entropy principle is proposed to propagate uncertainties in strut thickness, pore size, Young's modulus, and external forcing.
Result· The framework successfully quantifies the impact of input uncertainties on the stiffness of a porous femoral stem.
Validation· Validation is performed against experimental data from literature following ASME V&V standards.

Validation· Validation is limited to numerical simulation without experimental fabrication or testing.

边界: This paper does not quantify stress shielding, micromotion, or bone-implant interface mechanics; it focuses on geometric variability for multibody simulation rather than FE-based implant analysis.
动机· 股骨形状变异影响多体仿真精度，需量化个体差异。
方法· 基于CT数据集分析股骨几何参数（CCD角、股骨偏距等）。

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To quantify femoral shape and size variability from CT data for improving patient-specific multibody simulation in THA planning.
Method· Segmented CT datasets were used to measure biomechanical hip parameters such as CCD angle and femoral offset across individuals.
